content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: On purchase order:new, a blocking coverage overlay appears about 6 ms after Save is clicked and is removed about 6 s later in all three sessions, with no visible, console or exception errors in that window, which suggests the Save step holds the screen until its work completes.", "fix": "Fix: On the purchase order:new screen, change the Save button's click handler so it shows an inline loading state on the Save button and does not raise the full-screen overlay, and instrument the save call it waits on to find out why it takes about 6 s.", "cited_event_ids": ["415", "417:w439", "420", "421:x452", "419", "421:w458", "424", "425:x468", "426:w490", "429", "430:x496"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The purpose and content of the overlay are not in the events; it is only labelled 'overlay shown' and 'overlay removed'.", "No network request or server response appears in the windows, so the 6 s delay cannot be tied to a specific request.", "The second click on Save at x=0, y=0 (ids 420, 424, 429) may be synthetic or keyboard-driven; its cause is not determined.", "Whether the save succeeded is not visible in the windows, although the sessions continue to Submit afterwards.", "Abandonment is not observed in these windows, so the outcome is taken from the insight facts as given."]}
